Dear [CONSUMER NAME],

Re: Dispute of Account ACC-359295

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute letter regarding the account ACC-359295, which is currently in our possession for collection. You have disputed this account as being inaccurate and not belonging to you.

We understand that you have requested an investigation into this matter. We will conduct a review of the account to determine the validity of your dispute. As required by the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), we will investigate your dispute and verify the accuracy of the debt.

We have reviewed the account records and confirm that the account is in our possession for collection. The original creditor of the account is Lakeshore Utilities, and the account was charged off on 2020-08-22. The last payment made on the account was on 2021-03-22, and the current balance is 2896.26.

We will provide you with a written validation of the debt, as required by the FDCPA, within 30 days of receiving your dispute. We will also provide you with a copy of the verification of the debt, which will include the original creditor's name and address, the amount of the debt, and the date of the last payment.

Please note that under Kentucky state law, you have the right to dispute the debt and request that it be removed from your credit report if it is found to be inaccurate.

We will continue to investigate this matter and will provide you with an update on the status of our investigation. If you have any further questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Sincerely,

[AGENCY NAME]
